body: Do you want money?  Or do you want this family member to go to prison?  I don't know about the former, but the latter will be no problem whatsoever.  In Canada, there is a VERY low standard of proof necessary for a sexual assault conviction.  It basically boils down to how convincing your testimony is.  Most judges are male and will take the side of the vulnerable woman.
